<thought>We need to determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups in the compound present in the sample. The most direct way is to retrieve the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample, which will show signals for carbon atoms. Methyl carbons typically appear in the upfield region (around 10–30 ppm). By counting distinct signals in that region we can infer the number of CH₃ groups. We'll request the carbon NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
